title: I like music I hate exams
subtitle: music / the music
summary: Do not use the when you talk about things in general; use the only when you mean one special thing or these things here.

lesson.heading: Three people say what they think
lesson.text: A young man plays his guitar next to two big speakers. He says: *I like music.* Four students sit in an exam room and look worried. One of them says: *I hate exams.* A man walks through the snow in a big coat. He says: *I don't like cold weather.* All these sentences are about things **in general**, so there is no *the*.

examples.text: I'm not very good at writing **letters**.

lesson.heading: Games, sports, languages and school subjects
lesson.text: We never use **the** with games and sports, and we never use it with languages or school subjects.

left.label: In general - no the
examples: I don't like **cold weather**. (= cold weather in general)

right.label: These ones here - the
examples: I love this garden. **The flowers** are beautiful.
We had a great meal last night. **The fish** was excellent.
Do you know much about **the history** of your country?

lesson.heading: All of them, or these ones?
lesson.text: Before a noun, ask yourself one question: am I talking about all of them, everywhere? Then use no *the*. Am I talking about these ones, here or in this story? Then use **the**.

examples.text: I enjoy taking **photographs**. It's my hobby. (photographs in general)
Do you want to see **the photographs** that I took on holiday? (these ones)
I don't like **milk**. I never drink it.
*A:* Where's **the milk**? *B:* It's in the fridge. (= our milk)

lesson.text: *I like this town. I like **the people** here.* The word *here* tells you it is not people in general, so you need **the**.

exercises.explanation: Vegetables in general, so no the.
friends in general, so no the.
No the with games and sports.

exercises.prompt: Match the two halves of each conversation.

pairs.right: She doesn't go to parties very often.

pairs.left: We went for a swim in the river.

exercises.prompt: I don't like ___. I never drink it.
exercises.explanation: milk in general, so no the.
Not milk in general, but our milk, so we say the milk.
No the with the names of languages.

exercises.statement: I went shopping this morning. Shops were very busy.
exercises.explanation: I went shopping this morning. The shops were very busy. You mean the shops in this town, not shops in general.

exercises.statement: I don't like swimming in the cold water.
exercises.explanation: I don't like swimming in cold water. This is cold water in general, so there is no the.

exercises.prompt: Does the gap need the, or nothing at all?

items.text: I enjoy taking ___ photographs. It's my hobby.
'Do you do any sports?' 'Yes, I play ___ basketball.'
Jane doesn't go to ___ parties very often.
I can't sing this song. I don't know ___ words.
___ houses in this street are all the same.
Excuse me, can you pass ___ salt, please?
I like this town. I like ___ people here.

exercises.prompt: Do you want to see ___ that I took when I was on holiday?
exercises.explanation: These are special photographs - the ones you took on holiday.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the right order.
exercises.explanation: Money and happiness are general ideas, so neither takes the.
